changelog.text: Unit 3 aligned to the 2026 faculty material (counters slides, handwritten Unit III and Mealy/Moore notes, Dr K. Badari Nath's three counter lectures): the four ripple configurations, mod-N by clear, f_max, the CIE 2025 / CIE-II 2025 / SEE 2024 counter questions, the self-correcting T design from the lecture, 1101 / 111 / 101 sequence detectors (Mealy and Moore), Mealy-to-Moore conversion and four analysis examples; 10 new figures. Six slips in the faculty answers are corrected and marked.
More questions split into clear givens and parts; given data now shows above the hidden answer.
Questions are easier to read, and answers are now hidden until you press Show answer (or use the Answers switch).
Removed citation text that duplicated the source chips.
Added source chips to topic sections and sourced worked questions; derived examples remain labelled in the audit.
Existing source citations now link to the original PDFs and textbook entries on the Sources page.

Solved the CIE-I 2026 (12-10-2026) Unit 2 questions: Q3a 4:1 MUX realisation of Σm(1,3,4,6,10,12,13,14), Q3b analysis of the given MUX (F = A′B + BC′ + AB′C), Q4b three-sensor 3:8 decoder (Y0 = D1+D2+D4, Y1 = D3+D5+D6, Y2 = D7), with two new figures; Q4a (4-bit CLA) linked in the question bank.

Unit 1 aligned to Dr K.B. Ramesh's Computer Arithmetic notes: teacher's trace layouts and worked examples (unsigned multiplication, Booth, restoring division), overflow rule, sign extension, IEEE 754 double precision, Radix-4 Modified Booth naming, and all five Unit-1 questions from CIE-I 2026 solved.

Shift registers (§7.1) aligned to the 2026 faculty notes: Q3–Q0 / P3–P0 notation, Load/Shift 0 = shift, applications, shift-left SISO, circular SR, USR operation + worked example, and the CIE-II 2024/2025 register designs (§7.2.1).
Light/dark toggle moved to the top-right so it no longer covers the Suggest / report button.
Added ▶ Videos buttons: 104 hand-checked short videos from Neso Academy, ALL ABOUT ELECTRONICS and Gate Smashers, with a note where a video differs from the notes.
First ADLD release: Unit 1, Unit 2 (combinational + sequential halves in one guide) and Unit 3, aligned to the new syllabus.
